title: Kafka east cert-rotate: rolling reissue
description: Re-issues each broker Vault-PKI leaf from its own agent token (pki_int/issue/kafka-broker) + kafka-tls-split.sh + rolling restart (one at a time).

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: 3 brokers each show a new serial, rolling, no error

whatProves: cert-rotate reissues mTLS leaves with zero quorum loss (KRaft tolerates 1 down).
